intro.data: Look up a user's email, then look up that email's host. Each lookup returns a BOX (it might fail). 'bind' chains them: run the first, feed its contents into the next, flatten the result. The tray holds the lookups and bind machines (faithful and impostor); bring the right ones onto the board and wire one pipeline. Two test cases keep you honest — Ada has a host, Bo does NOT — so the pipeline must find Ada's host AND report Nothing for Bo (a bind that invents a host passes Ada but fails Bo).
intro.alchemy: Distil a herb's essence, then distil that essence's salt. Each step returns a VIAL (it might be empty). 'bind' chains them. The tray holds the steps and decant apparatus (faithful and impostor); bring the right ones onto the board and wire one line. Two cases keep you honest — Sage yields a salt, Rue does NOT — so the line must find Sage's salt AND report empty for Rue.
intro.spellcraft: Divine a rune's omen, then divine that omen's sign. Each step returns a CHARM (it might fizzle). 'bind' chains them. The tray holds the workings (faithful and impostor); bring the right ones onto the board and wire one weave. Two cases keep you honest — Ash yields a sign, Bramble does NOT — so the weave must find Ash's sign AND report dark for Bramble.
intro.abstract: Just x means the value x is present; Nothing means absent; bind runs the next step on a Just but passes Nothing straight through. From the tray bring f : A → T(B) and bind g : T(B) → T(C) and wire A to T(C). Two cases: a₁ succeeds (ends Just host), a₂ short-circuits (ends Nothing); a fabricating bind passes a₁ but fails a₂, so leave the impostors behind.

goal.data: Bring the faithful machines from the tray and wire one pipeline that finds Ada's host AND reports Nothing for Bo.
goal.alchemy: Bring the faithful apparatus from the tray and wire one line that finds Sage's salt AND reports empty for Rue.
goal.spellcraft: Bring the faithful workings from the tray and wire one weave that finds Ash's sign AND reports dark for Bramble.
goal.abstract: Bring f and bind g from the tray and wire A to T(C), passing both the success case and the short-circuit case.

afterSuccess.data: Both cases passed with ONE pipeline: bind ran the host lookup on the email inside the box, and when Bo had no host it honestly reported Nothing. The 'Invent Host' bind sailed through Ada but failed Bo — a single happy-path test would have missed it. That's why bind threads the 'might be empty' through every step automatically.
afterSuccess.alchemy: Both cases passed with one pipeline: bind worked on the essence inside the vial, and when Rue had no salt it honestly reported empty. 'Invent Salt' passed Sage but failed Rue.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: Both cases passed with one working: bind worked on the omen inside the charm, and when Bramble had no sign it honestly reported dark. 'Invent Sign' passed Ash but failed Bramble.
afterSuccess.abstract: f then bind g passed both the success case and the short-circuit case; bind = join ∘ T(g) propagates ∅. A fabricating bind only fails on the empty case — which is exactly why the empty case is in the suite.

reveal.summary: bind chains a step that returns a box: bind : T(A) → (A → T(B)) → T(B), mapping the step over the box then flattening (join). Crucially it threads the effect — here 'might be empty' — through every step, so failure propagates instead of being papered over.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: user.flatMap(getEmail).flatMap(getHost) — one missing link yields None, with no host invented.
